subject: Change request: switch to virtual settlement account + update AP contact
messages:
From: Asha Khatri <asha.khatri@mosaiclogistics.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@mosaiclogistics.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Bank update request + new AP contact (Mosaic Logistics)

Hi Dylan,

We're updating our receivables setup across a few of our enterprise customers. Can Redwood switch Mosaic Logistics' settlement to our new virtual account structure (VA- ending 0321) and point invoices to our AP distribution alias going forward (procurement@mosaiclogistics.com)?

I've attached an updated bank letter and a W-9. We need the change effective for invoices dated on/after Feb 1, 2026. Let me know if you need a signed addendum or any verification steps from Redwood's side.

Thanks,
Asha Khatri
Head of Finance Operations
Mosaic Logistics

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bank update request + new AP contact (Mosaic Logistics)

Thanks Asha — looping in AP and Finance. Quick list of items we need to complete the vendor record update and schedule the change:

- Completed vendor update form (we have a short e-form that captures remit preferences).
- Scanned bank letter (we have what you attached but AP may need a bank confirmation on bank letter letterhead).
- Updated primary AP contact + email for our portal.
- Confirmation of effective date (you noted Feb 1, which is fine but will need a final confirmation by Jan 20).

Naomi / Marcus — can you confirm the internal checklist and whether we need a signed addendum for switching to a virtual account? If AP needs DocuSign, I can request it from Mosaic.

Thanks,
Dylan
Business Development Manager | Redwood Inference
[Sent from my mobile]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Asha Khatri <asha.khatri@mosaiclogistics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 10:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bank update request + new AP contact (Mosaic Logistics)

Hi all,

Quick AP checklist/status:

- Vendor update form: please fill and return the short e-form here: https://redwood-invoice-portal.internal/vendor-update
- Bank letter: the PDF attached looks good; we'll need it to include a bank contact and verification line OR a bank confirmation email. If you can ask your bank to send a verification to ap@redwoodinference.com that will speed things up.
- W-9: received and uploaded.
- Virtual account (VA) routing: Finance requires a signed addendum only when changing legal beneficiary or tax details — switching to a VA for settlements that still route to the same legal entity usually does not require a separate contract amendment. I'll mark this as "administrative" if the beneficiary name and tax ID are unchanged.

Asha — can you confirm the legal entity name on your invoices (exact line for tax purposes) and whether the VA uses the same EIN? Also please provide a confirmation by 2026-01-20 to hit Feb 1 effective date.

I'll start a PO route update ticket once we have the e-form and bank verification.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Accounts Payable Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor_update_form_link.txt (text/plain)]

From: Asha Khatri <asha.khatri@mosaiclogistics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

- Legal entity on invoices: Mosaic Logistics, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — same EIN; beneficiary unchanged.
- Bank verification: bank_letter_vacct.pdf is signed by our bank relationship manager and includes the verification block (see page 2). I've also asked the bank to send a confirmation email to ap@redwoodinference.com; they said they'll do so within 48 hours.
- E-form: completed the vendor update e-form (link submitted, confirmation id: VU-20260113-998).
- Effective date: February 1, 2026 is confirmed.

Attachments re-sent for convenience: [W9_Mosaic_202601.pdf] [bank_letter_vacct.pdf]

Next steps as we understand them:
1) Naomi to open PO routing ticket and schedule settlement change on Feb 1.
2) Marcus to update our vendor record and add the AP alias procurement@mosaiclogistics.com as the primary invoice address.
3) Dylan will share any DocuSign if Finance later requests an addendum.

Please confirm when the PO route ticket is created and share the ticket id so our billing team can map remittances.

Thanks,
Asha
Head of Finance Operations | Mosaic Logistics
